config.global-should-decay.name: Global Should Decay
config.global-should-decay.description:
Disables Decay globally, meaning all fences will never decay.
This also repairs all existing fences.
config.global-decay-speed.name: Global Decay Speed
config.global-decay-speed.description:
The speed at which all fences decay compared to vanilla.
The higher the value, the faster they decay, and vice versa.
1.0 is unchanged/vanilla.
config.global-remove-variation.name: Global Remove Variation
config.global-remove-variation.descripti:
By default, all fences gain approximately +/-100 health points of variation off their base health when placed and repaired.
This option removes that variation, making all fences of the same type last the same amount of days.
config.per-fence-config.name: Settings Per Fence Type
config.per-fence-config.description: Settings per fence type, so that you can further customize each type.
config.ignore-global.name: Ignore Global
config.ignore-global.description: Ignore the global settings for this fence type.
config.should-decay.name: Should Decay
config.should-decay.description:
Disables Decay, meaning this fence will never decay.
This also repairs existing fences of this type.
config.decay-speed.name: Decay Speed
config.decay-speed.description:
The speed at which this type of fence decays compared to vanilla.
The higher the value, the faster they decay, and vice versa.
1.0 is unchanged/vanilla.
config.remove-variation.name: Remove Variation
config.remove-variation.description:
By default, all fences gain approximately +/-100 health points of variation off their base health when placed and repaired.
This option removes that variation, making all fences of this type last the same amount of days.
